# Chaikin Money Flow

*Accumulation over N bars divided by volume, -1 to 1.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Chaikin Money Flow** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `20` |
| Color | color | `"#43A047"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/cmf.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Chaikin Money Flow", shortTitle: "CMF", overlay: false, precision: 3 });
const length = input.int("Length", 20, { min: 1 });
const mfv = ta.calc([candle.high, candle.low, candle.close, candle.volume], (h, l, c, v) => (h - l ? ((2 * c - l - h) / (h - l)) * v : 0));
plot(ta.calc([ta.sum(mfv, length), ta.sum(candle.volume, length)], (m, v) => (v ? m / v : NaN)), { title: "MF", color: input.color("Color", "#43A047", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
